meta.title: Tab titles auto-number repeated stage modes
gaps: Match tab labels using unanchored regular expressions such as /technical stage/i; catalog element-name selectors require exact visible names.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Match tab labels using unanchored regular expressions such as /technical stage/i; catalog element-name selectors require exact visible names.

steps.note: Open the project creation screen with stage tabs.
Establish the first Technical stage before adding another.
Open the menu for adding the second stage.
Add a second Technical stage under the case's legal-duplicate premise.
Verify the first Technical tab retains its unnumbered label.
Verify the second Technical tab receives the numeric suffix.
